name: Riverland Industries, Inc.
old_description: Since opening in 1999 as a manufacturer of dry ATH, our story has been one of constant expansion and evolution. We’ve been growing for over 25 years — and every year marks an exciting new development in our capabilities. Here are just some of the highlights.
about:
Riverland Industries, Inc. opened in 1999 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, as a manufacturer of dry aluminum trihydrate (ATH). The company has expanded steadily over more than 25 years, evolving from a single-product operation into a full-service toll manufacturer. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

Today Riverland operates as an industrial toll manufacturer, offering custom material processing across a range of unit operations. Its capabilities include size reduction, size separation, heat treating, impregnation, forming, blending, extrusion, particle size reduction, flash calcination, and granulation. Key equipment includes an indirect rotary kiln capable of product temperatures up to 815 °C and air classifiers for fine particle separation. An in-house laboratory provides moisture analysis, particle size distribution, surface area measurement, and porosimetry. The facility also provides warehousing, packaging, and freight management, with direct access to river, rail, and interstate transportation corridors. Headcount is listed as two employees in public records.

The company serves customers in petrochemical, chemical, food-grade, air purification, and water treatment markets. It specializes in adsorbent materials and has produced spherical alumina for a global producer. Partners typically engage Riverland for collaborative process engineering, flexible capital investment, and the design and deployment of dedicated equipment and facilities.

Riverland emphasizes scalable infrastructure and a flexible capital investment model that allows partner-driven expansion. Its collaborative process engineering approach and direct multimodal logistics access are cited as key differentiators, enabling fast, cost-efficient transport and customized facility design.
